# Question 2

```{r}
install.packages("ggplot2")
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
set.seed(10)
theta <- 0.75
rand <- runif(5000, min=0, max = 1)

weighted_func <- c()
for(i in 1:5000){
weighted_func[i] <- if(rand[i]<0.75){rnorm(1, mean =0, sd = 1)} else {rnorm(1, mean = 3, sd = 1)}
}
df <- data.frame(y= weighted_func)

ggplot(df, aes(x=y))+
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), color = "black", binwidth = 0.5) +  
  geom_density(color = "red", size = 1.2) 


```
